column1: # This file contains a large set of text fragments used to validate DEDUCE. It contains 12 tab-delimited columns:
# 0) the record ID. Is not used in the testing code and its only purpose is to ease find a test case for a human user [Rec_ID]
# 1) the failure / pass status. 'F' denotes that this record produces a known failure. 'P' denotes that it should pass. Values must be in capitals [Pass_or_Fail]
# The following patient data fields are obtained from Snowflake: VOORNAAM, INITIALEN, EIGENNAAM, PARTNERNAAM, FIRSTNAMES, PAT_MRN_ID, ADRES_REGEL_1, WOONPLAATS
# The last two columns are the identifiable_input and the expected_output from DEDUCE

# The following test records have been temporarily marked as failing because in the first 2 production runs the ‘dates’ and ‘age’ annotator groups are disabled. These test-cases assumed that the both groups are active.
# A great propotion of the failure is due to case sensitive matching of locations, names etc.
